# 2 Baruch Chapter 75 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 75:5 — Baruch's election justified

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "if-you-were-not-worthy to-receive-this-revelation, you-would-not-have-been-shown-these-things" |
| LOGOS | "if you were not worthy to receive this revelation, you would not have been shown these things" |
| PNEUMA | "if you were not worthy to receive this revelation, you would never have been shown these things" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA adds 'never' for emphasis, which is not in the Syriac; the conditional logic is clear enough without the intensifier.

---

## 75:8 — encouragement formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "be-of-good-courage, and-do-not-be-afraid" |
| LOGOS | "be of good courage, and do not be afraid" |
| PNEUMA | "take heart and do not be afraid" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Be of good courage' (Syriac: ethhayyel) is a standard prophetic encouragement phrase; LOGOS preserves the traditional rendering while PNEUMA's 'take heart' is more colloquial.
